name: SuperCMO Skills
use_label: AI agent makes ad videos and images
one_liner: Marketing skills that let an AI agent turn a product photo and a brief into ad videos and images.

text.why: A small shop needs filming, casting and editing for even one ad video. Give the agent a product photo and a brief and SuperCMO has it extract product details, pick suitable image and video models, cast AI actors and edit the result.
text.take: It presents itself as an open-source alternative to closed AI marketing agents.
build: A set of skills installed into agents such as Claude, Cursor, Codex and Hermes. The README shows example requests: a get-ready-with-me reel for a T-shirt, a 3D cartoon ad for a tumbler, an ad video for an energy drink. Install with one line: npx github:SupercmoHQ/superCMO-skills --all.

who.role: Small business owners and marketers who have product photos but no capacity to produce ad videos.

start.text: Install into your agent with npx github:SupercmoHQ/superCMO-skills --all, then describe the ad you want along with a product photo.

caveat: The fees for the AI image and video models that produce the output, and the output quality, could not be confirmed here. Recently released, with 62 stars.

license.scope_text: Commercial use, redistribution OK. Keep notices; mark changes.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
